datasetLicense: CC-BY-SA-4.0; passage-level provenance and attribution are in the original dataset. Texts are fetched for local evaluation and not redistributed in this report.
selection: All 155 pre-2022 Wikipedia passages, 183 pre-2022 PMC passages, 56 dataset-labelled 2026 AI passages; literature negative control excluded; no score-based selection.
protocol: Frozen TMR Q8 model and frozen HC3 calibration (slope 3, intercept -11). No fitting, threshold selection or weight updates on this stress test.
limitations: Vendor-authored small evaluation set; source labels and generator identities are publisher assertions, not independently authenticated.
Two genres; no representative current user base rates. Unknown model-training overlap.
Passages may share articles or prompts; sample counts are not independent trials.
No proprietary competitor scores inferred from this evaluation.
